allowAgentAnswers.description:
AllowAgentAnswers lets the session that fired the mission answer its
unit's questions with its own model instead of waiting for a human.

maxAgentAnswers.description:
MaxAgentAnswers caps how many of this mission's questions an agent may
answer; zero means the default cap (DefaultMaxAgentAnswers), never unlimited.

allowAgentApprovals.description:
AllowAgentApprovals lets an adjudicating agent rule on this mission's
approve-tier tool calls instead of the unit waiting for a human.

maxAgentApprovals.description:
MaxAgentApprovals caps how many of this mission's gated tool calls an
agent may decide; zero means DefaultMaxAgentApprovals, never unlimited.

AttentionBounds.description:
AttentionBounds is the envelope's say over who may answer a unit's
question; the zero value means only a human may.

ComputeBounds.description:
ComputeBounds is the envelope's compute half: an opt-in ceiling on a
mission's total compute, alongside the per-tool action rules; zero/absent
is unbounded and exhaustion is never silent (see OnExhausted).

Condition.description: Condition is a single key/op/value predicate applied to the args of a tool call.

timeout_s.description:
TimeoutS is how long to wait for a human response when Action is
ActionApprove; 0 means block indefinitely.

on_timeout.description:
OnTimeout is the fallback when the approval window expires; only
"deny" or "approve" is valid (allow would silently bypass approval).

Rule.description:
Rule matches a tools+tool pair (with optional AND-conditions) and assigns
an action.

dirs.description:
Dirs are absolute directories a resolved binary may live under, at any
depth; symlinks are resolved on both sides before comparison.

hashes.description:
Hashes maps an absolute REAL path (post-symlink-resolution) to its hex
SHA256; a declared symlink never matches.

TrustedBinaries.description:
TrustedBinaries is the envelope's identity+integrity block, declared once
per policy; Dirs and Hashes are both opt-in and independent, and an absent
or empty block changes nothing.

version.description:
Version is the envelope's wire version (see PolicySchemaVersion);
absent (0) means PolicySchemaVersion.

attention.description:
Attention is the optional attention half: who may answer a unit's
question (see AttentionBounds); nil means a human must.

trusted_binaries.description:
TrustedBinaries gates every allow a command_prefix_allowlist would
grant on the identity and integrity of the resolved binary (see
TrustedBinaries); nil is inert.
